en.title: One Chicago, Abbott Elementary Return: Your Wednesday TV Guide
en.summary: Get ready for your mid-week television fix. The beloved halls of Abbott Elementary and the intense streets of Chicago are back with new seasons.
en.body:
Get ready to set your DVRs and clear your schedules, because Wednesday, October 7, 2026, is a major night for returning series and exciting new debuts. The long-running, fan-favorite **One Chicago** franchise is back in full force on NBC. **Chicago Fire** kicks off its monumental 15th season at 8:00 p.m., followed by **Chicago Med** at 9:00 p.m., and **Chicago P.D.** at 10:00 p.m. These shows have consistently delivered high-stakes drama and compelling character arcs, making their return a significant event for their dedicated viewership.

Meanwhile, over on ABC, the halls of **Abbott Elementary** will once again be filled with the earnest energy of its dedicated teachers. The beloved mockumentary-style sitcom returns for its sixth season at 8:30 p.m., promising more heartwarming laughs and relatable classroom chaos. Fans have eagerly awaited the continuation of Janine, Gregory, and the rest of the faculty's journeys, especially after the cliffhangers and character developments from the previous season.

## A New Kind of Terror Arrives

Beyond the familiar comfort of these returning favorites, Wednesday also marks the premiere of a highly anticipated reimagining of a horror classic. Prime Video is set to release **Carrie**, a new take on Stephen King's iconic story of a telekinetic outcast. While details about this specific adaptation are still emerging, the prospect of a fresh interpretation of such a well-known narrative, especially from a filmmaker known for their genre work, is sure to pique the interest of horror aficionados and King fans alike. Apple TV+ also enters the fray with the debut of **Small Prophets**, adding another option to the night's stacked lineup.

## Fan Anticipation Reaches Fever Pitch

The return of these established series and the debut of new projects signal a robust fall television season. For the **One Chicago** faithful, the premiere is an annual ritual, a chance to reconnect with the firefighters, doctors, and detectives they've followed for years. The sheer longevity of these shows speaks to their ability to evolve and maintain relevance. Similarly, **Abbott Elementary** has carved out a significant niche, becoming a bright spot in network television with its optimistic portrayal of public education and its stellar ensemble cast. The anticipation for season six is palpable, with fans discussing potential storylines and character pairings online.

## What's Next

With **Chicago Fire**, **Chicago Med**, **Chicago P.D.**, and **Abbott Elementary** all premiering on October 7, 2026, this Wednesday is packed. Additionally, keep an eye out for the new **Carrie** on Prime Video and **Small Prophets** on Apple TV+ as you plan your viewing.
